capabilities: Prompt for a folder when clicking an unresolved link
Filter existing folders by typing and press Enter to create the note
Create missing folders and the note at once from a typed path
Show recently used folders at the top of the picker
Cancel creation with Esc so nothing is written
extras: README states the plugin works entirely offline and makes no network requests; only one setting (number of recent folders, 0-20).
intentEvidence: Without it, Obsidian uses its default location.
problem: Obsidian creates new notes from unresolved links in a fixed default location, so notes end up in the wrong folder unless you move them afterwards.

relations.evidence: This plugin pairs well with Templater (open in Obsidian).

summary: Folder picker that prompts for a location when you click a link to a note that doesn't exist yet, instead of using the default folder.
